sentences.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  SPECIAL CIVIL APPLICATION NO. 3603 of 2013 ==========================================================
 MADHUKAR KANSARA....Petitioner(s)
 Versus  VADODARA MUNICIPAL CORPORATION & 2....Respondent(s)
==========================================================
Appearance:
MR SP MAJMUDAR, ADVOCATE for the Petitioner(s) No. 1 MR DHAVAL D VYAS, ADVOCATE for the Respondent(s) No. 2 - 3 MR NILESH A PANDYA, ADVOCATE for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE K.J.THAKER  Date : 27/07/2015  ORAL ORDER

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is stated by Mr.Madhukar Kansara (i.e. petitioner) that he wants to do business in the shop, which is sealed and within a period of four days from today, he will make an application to the concerned authority with all undertakings that he himself shall do the business.
With the above observations, the matter is adjourned to 26.08.2015.

If the Highest Officer i.e.
Municipal Commissioner feels that the provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and other provisions will be complied with by the petitioner and after hearing the petitioner, the Commissioner to pass a reasoned order by that time. It is hoped that he shall take a sympathetical view as the petitioner himself wants to do the business and his shop is under sealed condition since last more than two years.

(K.J.THAKER, J) rakesh/
